title: Maira’s Dream · Second Chances — Sorted Donations
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Retail floorplan rework: long parallel double-sided hardgoods banks, twelve aligned clothing fixtures, perimeter books, clear cross-aisles and checkout at the front. Fixture-specific donated assortments with clustered spacing, partially empty shelves, capped duplicate appliances, plate stacks, leaning books and grounded book piles. Distinct tea-set pieces, radios, watering cans and sculpture. Plants restricted to perimeter/furniture corners. Goal hints approach the correct side of rotated fixtures. Compact phone list, thumbstick/touch look, staffed checkout, manager, escalating visits and cat/fire escape retained. Stylized browser prototype; further asset variety remains needed.
